content_blocks.text: Aegis Series-7 HCS — Operator Manual AEG-OM-700 Rev 4 Aegis Series-7 Hydraulic Control System Operator Manual Document AEG-OM-700 | Revision 4 | Applies to software revision 3.2 and later

The Aegis Series-7 Hydraulic Control System (HCS) provides closed-loop hydraulic pressure regulation for industrial press lines. The system is built around the Hydraulic Power Unit (HPU), which supplies pressurized fluid to the press circuit under the supervision of the HCS Controller (PLC-03). Throughout Aegis documentation the Hydraulic Power Unit may also be referred to as the Hydraulic Unit or the HP unit, depending on which department produced the document. All three terms refer to the same physical assembly.

Reference Component Function HPU Hydraulic Power Unit Generates and regulates hydraulic pressure IV-21 Isolation Valve 21 Isolates the HPU from the press circuit PS-04A Pressure Sensor 04A Reports HPU discharge pressure to PLC-03 PLC-03 HCS Controller Supervises startup, monitoring, and alarms Note: earlier Aegis units shipped with pressure sensor PS-04. As of software revision 3.2, PS-04 is superseded by PS-04A; see Engineering Change Notice ECN-1042 for details.

Before starting, verify: • Hydraulic fluid level is within the normal band on the sight glass. • Isolation valve IV-21 is OPEN. • The emergency stop circuit is RESET. WARNING: Do not start the Hydraulic Power Unit with the maintenance access panel removed. Rotating components inside the HPU housing are exposed when the panel is off. Startup sequence:
1 Turn the POWER selector to ON.

content_blocks.text: Normal HPU discharge pressure is 200 bar on software revision 3.2 and later. On revisions prior to 3.2, normal discharge pressure was 180 bar, measured by the original PS-04 sensor. Do not compare live readings against AEG-OM-700 Rev 4 | Page 1
Aegis Series-7 HCS — Operator Manual AEG-OM-700 Rev 4 the 180 bar figure on a unit running revision 3.2 or later — the setpoint changed along with the sensor replacement.
See the Aegis Alarm Reference (AEG-AL-700) for the full alarm list, including alarm A17 (Hydraulic Pressure Low), its possible causes, and required operator actions.

Do not reset the PLC-03 controller while hydraulic pressure is above 50 bar. Resetting the controller under pressure can cause an uncommanded valve transition. Bleed pressure below 50 bar first, using the manual bleed procedure in Section 8, before performing a controller reset. AEG-OM-700 Rev 4 | Page 2
